install_command:
continuity remember -c cases -n mcp-apps-fleet-conversion-resumed -s "MCP Apps fleet conversion (WYREAI-163) resumed 2026-07-17: autotask-mcp reference PR #202 open; halopsa+datto-rmm replication agents dispatched; per-server track chosen" -b "Aaron directive 2026-07-17: get MCP Apps into each published MCP server = per-server (vendor-emits-resources) track, resolving the June-15 gateway-vs-per-server open question for WYREAI-163. Gateway branding cluster WYREAI-142-148 stays separate (card has window.__BRAND__ + BRAND_INJECT hook for it).

REFERENCE: autotask-mcp PR #202 (feat/mcp-apps-ticket-card) — ticket card on autotask_get_ticket_details, add-note round-trip via autotask_create_ticket_note. 149/149 tests, 10 new contract tests. Ported from ~/workspace/wyre-genui-spike (ext-apps ^1.7.3).

TEMPLATE (per-server recipe): (1) _meta with BOTH 'ui/resourceUri' flat key (canonical ext-apps RESOURCE_URI_META_KEY) AND nested ui.resourceUri; (2) ui://<vendor>/<entity>-card.html resource, MIME text/html;profile=mcp-app, vite single-file bundle EMBEDDED at build time as committed src/generated/*.ts (fs-less Workers can serve it); (3) server-side _card normalization attached to read-tool JSON (same bytes feed model + iframe); (4) max one write round-trip with server-resolved fail-safe defaults — autotask publish default must be internal-visibility only, else read-only card; (5) DOM-construction rendering, NO innerHTML (untrusted PSA data); (6) contract tests pinning wire shape.

GOTCHAS: autotask-mcp uses low-level SDK Server (not McpServer) so ext-apps registerAppTool helpers do not apply — emit wire shape manually; exactOptionalPropertyTypes blocks assigning undefined to optional props; npm install prepare fails before first build:ui generates src/generated (chicken-egg, harmless).

REMAINING: ~33 published *-mcp servers after autotask/halopsa/datto-rmm. Rollout in tranches after Aaron signs off PR #202. Fleet list = *-mcp repos with @wyre-technology non-private package.json (36 total)."
